# Introduction

This R Markdown document demonstrates how to print integers from 1 to 10 using R.

## R Code

The following code uses a for loop to print integers from 1 to 10.

```{r}
for (i in 1:10) {
  print(i)
}
```

## Conclusion

The R for loop successfully prints all integers from 1 to 10.
